entity_raw.definition_raw: Ancestors SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): ReposeAssociated Deities: Acavna, Anubis, Ashava, Bergelmir, Fharaas, Ghenshau, Magrim, Myr, Osiris, Pharasma, Ragadahn, Rhan-Tegoth, Selket, Shizuru, The Lost Prince, Tsukiyo, YhidothrusReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the ward against death power of the Repose domain. Speak With Dead (Su): At 8th level, as a standard action, you can ask one question of a dead creature as if using speak with dead. The dead creature you are questioning does not gain a Will saving throw if your alignments are different. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your cleric level.Replacement Domain Spells: 4th—rest eternal, 6th—geas/quest.
